one.question: What is CapCar?
one.answer: A digital garage for planning changes, finding parts and keeping your vehicle’s maintenance and build history together.

two.question: Do I need an account to search for parts?
two.answer: No. Search publicly, then create an account when you want your own garage.

three.question: Will every part be confirmed to fit?
three.answer: No. Coverage varies. Confirm the vehicle specification, part number and installation requirements before buying.

four.question: Can I visualize any modification on my exact car?
four.answer: Not yet. Concept Studio offers selected visual references. Models and controls vary, and previews do not prove fitment.

five.question: Where do I buy the parts?
five.answer: Retailer purchases are completed on the retailer’s website. CapCar does not take payment for those orders.

six.question: Is my garage public?
six.answer: Your personal garage is private. Review the information before sharing a public passport or publishing a listing.

seven.question: Do I need a modified car to start?
seven.answer: No. Start with the car you have and the next thing you want to maintain, improve or document.
